title: Franka Mobile FR3 Duo (TMR base, spine, two FR3 + hands), route contact variant solref 0.00125 s (Alloy's route step only)
licence: Apache-2.0 (frankarobotics/franka_description; gains and pose: gym-anything/robotics mobile-fr3-duo, MIT)
world: floor z = 0, the robot on it; table 1.2 x 1.2 m, top 0.75 m, x 0.7-1.9 m in front; box, cylinder and T14's mug on it as for tabletop
changes: visual-only geoms and their meshes, materials and textures dropped

source keyframes dropped; keyframe 'init' = start state (robot start pose, ctrl = its joint targets, objects at rest), both clipped into the joint ranges; free-floating robots lifted so the deepest floor contact just touches
collision hulls above 64 vertices split into convex pieces within 0.2 mm (hull_split.json)

robot self-pairs overlapping > 0.5 mm at the start pose, or at qpos0 (where alloy.build starts a robot), excluded: H1-2's wrist yaw | thumb proximal, each hand; the Franka arms' link5 | hand (Panda) or link7 (FR3), whose hulls overlap 5.6-43 mm at qpos0 and 15-33 mm at joint6's lower limit; none elsewhere
options: jacobian sparse; <flag multiccd="disable"/> written out (Alloy's MJCF route, as for T12: Newton reads an absent flag as off, MuJoCo as on; explicit, both read off)

Duo wheels (two casters, two drive wheels): solref 0.02 -> 0.005 s and solimp 0.9 0.95 -> 0.95 0.99. The URDF has no contact parameters; at MuJoCo's defaults the 0.2 kg casters rested 10.0 mm inside a rigid floor under the 328 kg robot; they now rest 0.43 mm deep. Shapes and friction unchanged (alloy.tasks.emb_robots.firm_wheels)

route contact variant of emb_e5_fr3_duo: every geom's solref set to [0.00125, 1.0] (time constant = 2 x Alloy's route step 0.000625 s, MuJoCo's floor; damping ratio); a solimp softer than MuJoCo's default (dmin < 0.9; Go2's feet) set to the default, as in _stiff; friction, margins, stiffer solimp and everything else as the verdict scene

contact.valid: valid at Alloy's route step (0.000625 s) only: an engine at the sources' 2 ms step clamps the time constant to 4 ms (MuJoCo's 2 dt floor)
